zh: 任意两个相邻日志事件之间，CPU 只被调用栈顶的那个函数占用；结束事件的那个时间戳本身也属于结束的函数。
用栈模拟调用关系，并记录上一个事件之后的起始时刻 prev；每来一个事件，就把 prev 到该事件之间的时间记到当前栈顶函数上。
遇到 start：若栈非空，给栈顶加 ts−prev，然后把新函数压栈，prev=ts；遇到 end：给栈顶加 ts−prev+1（包含结束这一秒）并弹栈，prev=ts+1；最后按编号输出每个函数的独占时间。
en: Between two consecutive log events the CPU is used only by the function on top of the call stack; the timestamp of an end event itself still belongs to the finishing function.
Simulate the calls with a stack and remember prev, the first time unit not yet assigned; on every event charge the time from prev up to that event to the function on top of the stack.

On start: if the stack is non-empty add ts - prev to its top, push the new function and set prev = ts; on end: add ts - prev + 1 to the top (the ending unit is included), pop it and set prev = ts + 1; finally print every function exclusive time in id order.

explanationEn:
## Approach

The top of the call stack is the function currently running. When a new event arrives, charge the time from prev up to just before the event to the top of the stack; a start pushes the new function, and an end charges the stretch including the ending unit to that function and pops it.

## Proof of correctness

Between two adjacent events only the function on top of the stack runs; at a start the CPU switches to the new top, and at an end the finishing function is charged with +1. Therefore every unit of execution time is assigned exactly to the function running at that time.

## Complexity

O(m) time, O(n) space.

## Source notes

Part of the original description is truncated, but the complete example it gives matches the standard definition of exclusive time; this site adds the serialization format of the logs.
